verses.t: word-of YHWH who has-been toward Hoshea son-of Beeri, in-days-of Uzziah Jotham Ahaz Hezekiah kings-of Judah ; and-in-days-of Jeroboam son-of Joash king-of Israel.
YHWH has-spoken beginning-of in-Hoshea ; YHWH and-has-said toward Hoshea walk take to/for-you woman-of fornications and-youths-of fornications, for fornicate will-fornicate the-land, after YHWH.
and-he-has-walked and-he-has-taken, Gomer daughter-of Diblaim ; and-she-has-conceived and-she-has-begotten to/for-him son.
YHWH and-has-said toward-him, call name-of-him Jezreel ; for still little and-I-have-reckoned bloods-of Jezreel on house-of Jehu, and-I-have-made-cease, kingdom-of house-of Israel.
the-he ; and-has-been in-the-day and-I-have-breaked bow-of Israel, in-valley-of Jezreel.

and-has-conceived still daughter and-has-begotten, and-has-said to/for-him, call name-of-her Lo Ruhama ; for not I-will-make-add still I-will-compassion house-of Israel, for lift I-will-lift to/for-them.
and-house-of Judah I-will-compassion, and-I-have-made-save-them in-YHWH god-of-them ; and-not I-will-make-save-them in-bow and-in-sword and-in-battle, in-horses and-in-horsemans.
and-she-has-weaned Lo Ruhama ; and-she-has-conceived and-she-has-begotten son.
and-has-said, call name-of-him Lo Not ; for you not people-of-me, and-I not will-be to/for-you-pl.

number-of sons-of Israel and-has-been like-sand-of the-sea, who not will-be-measured and-not will-be-recounted ; and-has-been in-place-of who will-be-said to/for-them not people-of-me you, will-be-said to/for-them sons-of El living.
sons-of Judah and-have-been-gathered and-sons-of Israel together, and-have-put to/for-them head one and-have-ascended from the-land ; for great day-of Jezreel.
say to/for-brothers-of-you-pl people-of-me ; and-to/for-sisters-of-you-pl she-has-been-compassioned.
contend in-mother-of-you-pl contend, for he not woman-of-me, and-I not man-of-her ; and-let-her-make-turn fornications-of-her from-faces-of-her, and-adulteries-of-her between breasts-of-her.

lest I-will-make-strip-her naked, and-I-have-made-set-her, like-day-of be-beget-of-her ; and-I-have-put-her like-the-wilderness and-I-have-set-her like-land dryness, and-I-have-made-die-her in-the-thirst.
and-sons-of-her not I-will-compassion ; for sons-of fornications they.

for mother-of-them has-fornicated, has-made-wither conceiving-of-them ; for has-said I-will-walk after loving-of-me giving-of food-of-me and-waters-of-me, wool-of-me and-flax-of-me, oil-of-me and-drinks-of-me.
to/for-thus lo-me hedging way-of-you-f in-the-thorn ; and-I-have-uped Wall-of-her, and-paths-of-her not she-will-find.

and-she-has-pursued loving-of-her and-not she-will-make-overtake them, and-she-has-sought-them and-not she-will-find ; and-she-has-said I-will-walk and-I-will-return toward man-of-me the-first, for good to/for-me then from-now.
and-he not has-known, for I have-given to/for-her, the-grain and-the-new and-the-oil ; and-silver I-have-made-multiply to/for-her and-gold they-have-done to/for-the-Baal.
to/for-thus I-will-return, and-I-have-taken grain-of-me in-time-of-him, and-new-of-me in-meeting-of-him ; and-I-have-made-rescue wool-of-me and-flax-of-me, to/for-cover nakedness-of-her.
and-now I-will-heglam lewdness-of-her to/for-eyes-of loving-of-her ; and-man not will-make-rescue-her from-hand-of-me.
and-I-have-made-cease all-of rejoicing-of-her, feast-of-her month-of-her and-sabbath-of-her ; and-all-of meeting-of-her.
and-I-have-made-desolate vine-of-her and-fig-of-her, who has-said wages they to/for-me, who have-given to/for-me loving-of-me ; and-I-have-put-them to/for-wood, beast-of the-field and-has-eaten-them.

and-I-have-reckoned on-her days-of the-Baal who will-make-offer to/for-them, and-has-adorned ring-of-her and-jewelry-of-her, and-has-walked after loving-of-her ; and-me she-has-forgotten utterance-of YHWH.
to/for-thus behold I enticing-of-her, and-have-made-walk-her the-wilderness ; and-I-have-spoken on heart-of-her.

and-I-have-given to/for-her vineyards-of-her from-there, and-valley-of Akhor to/for-entrance-of hope ; and-she-has-answered there-ward like-days-of youths-of-her, and-like-day-of ascend-of-her from-land-of Egypt.
the-he and-has-been in-the-day utterance-of YHWH, you-f-will-call man-of-me ; and-not you-f-will-call to/for-me still Baal-of-me.
and-I-have-made-turn names-of the-Baal from-lip-of-her ; and-not they-will-be-remembered still in-name-of-them.

and-I-have-cut to/for-them covenant in-the-day the-he, with beast-of the-field and-with bird-of the-heavens, and-creeping-of the-ground ; and-bow and-sword and-battle I-will-break from the-land, and-I-have-made-lie-them to/for-security.
and-I-have-betrothed-you-f to/for-me to/for-age ; and-I-have-betrothed-you-f to/for-me in-righteousness and-in-justice, and-in-kindness and-in-compassions.
and-I-have-betrothed-you-f to/for-me in-faithfulness ; and-you-f-have-known YHWH.
the-he and-has-been in-the-day I-will-answer utterance-of YHWH, I-will-answer the-heavens ; and-they will-answer the-land.
and-the-land will-answer, the-grain and-the-new and-the-oil ; and-they will-answer Jezreel.
and-I-have-sown-her to/for-me in-the-land, and-I-have-compassioned not compassion ; and-I-have-said to/for-not people people-of-me you, and-he will-say god-of-me.
YHWH and-has-said toward-me still walk love woman, loved-of neighbor and-commiting ; like-love YHWH sons-of Israel, and-they turning toward gods another, and-loving-of raisins-of grapes.
and-I-have-traded-her to/for-me, in-five ten silver ; and-homer-of barleys and-lethek-of barleys.
and-I-have-said toward-her days many you-f-will-dwell to/for-me, not you-f-will-fornicate, and-not you-f-will-be to/for-man ; and-also I toward-you-f.
for days many will-dwell sons-of Israel, naught king and-naught official, and-naught sacrifice and-naught pillar ; and-naught ephod and-teraphims.
after sons-of Israel will-return, and-have-sought YHWH god-of-them, and-David king-of-them ; and-they-have-dreaded toward YHWH and-toward goodness-of-him in-end-of the-days.
hear word-of YHWH sons-of Israel ; for strife to/for-YHWH with dwelling-of the-land, for naught truth and-naught kindness and-naught knowledge-of god in-the-land.
swear and-deceive, and-murder and-steal and-commit ; and-bloods have-broken, in-bloods have-touched.
on thus the-land will-mourn and-has-weakened all-of dwelling in-her, in-beast-of the-field and-in-bird-of the-heavens ; and-also fishes-of the-sea will-be-gathered.
surely man do-not let-contend and-do-not man let-make-rebuke ; and-people-of-you like-making-contend-of priest.
and-you-have-stumbled the-day, and-has-stumbled also prophet with-you night ; and-I-have-ceased mother-of-you.

they-have-been-ceased people-of-me from-without-of the-knowledge ; for you the-knowledge have-rejected and-will-reject-you from-minister to/for-me, and-have-forgotten instruction-of god-of-you, will-forget sons-of-you also I.
like-multiply-of-them thus they-have-sinned to/for-me ; glory-of-them in-dishonor I-will-make-change.
offense-of people-of-me they-will-eat ; and-toward iniquity-of-them they-will-lift soul-of-him.
and-he-has-been like-the-people like-the-priest ; and-I-have-reckoned on-him ways-of-him, and-deeds-of-him I-will-make-return to/for-him.
and-they-have-eaten and-not they-will-satisfy, they-have-made-fornicate and-not they-will-break ; for YHWH they-have-left to/for-keep.
heart will-take fornication and-wine and-new.
people-of-me in-tree-of-him will-ask, and-rod-of-him will-make-announce to/for-him ; for spirit-of fornications has-made-go, and-they-have-fornicated under god-of-them.

on heads-of the-mountains will-sacrifice and-on the-Gibat will-offer, under oak and-poplar and-oak for good shadow-of-her ; on thus daughters-of-you-pl will-fornicate, and-daughter-in-laws-of-you-pl will-commit.

not I-will-reckon on daughters-of-you-pl for will-fornicate and-on daughter-in-laws-of-you-pl for will-commit, for they with the-fornicating will-separate, and-with the-cult will-sacrifice ; and-people not will-discern will-be-ruined.
if fornicating you Israel, do-not let-guilty Judah ; and-do-not let-come the-Gilgal and-do-not let-ascend Beth-aven Aven, and-do-not let-be-sweared living YHWH.
for like-heifer rebeling, Israel has-rebelled ; now YHWH will-pasture-them, like-lamb in-the-broad.
united-of idols Ephraim make-rest to/for-him.
liquor-of-them has-turned ; make-fornicate have-made-fornicate, have-loved love dishonor shields-of-her.
spirit has-constrained her in-wings-of-her ; and-they-will-blush from-sacrifices-of-them.
hear this-f the-priests and-make-heed house-of Israel and-house-of the-king make-listen, for to/for-you-pl the-justice ; for snare you-pl-have-been to/for-Mizpah, and-net-of spreaded on Betabor.
and-slaughtering rebellions have-made-deep ; and-I discipline to/for-all-of-them.
I have-known Ephraim, and-Israel not has-been-hided from-me ; for now you-have-made-fornicate Ephraim, has-been-defiled Israel.
not deeds-of-them will-give, to/for-return toward god-of-them ; for spirit-of fornications in-entrails-of-them, and-YHWH not they-have-known.
pride-of Israel and-has-answered in-faces-of-him ; and-Israel and-Ephraim they-will-be-stumbled in-iniquity-of-them, has-stumbled also Judah with-them.
in-flock-of-them and-in-cattle-of-them they-will-walk to/for-seek YHWH and-not they-will-find ; he-has-rescued from-them.
in-YHWH sons stranger have-treacherouslied, for have-begotten ; now month will-eat-them with portions-of-them.
blow trumpet in-the-Gibeah, trumpet in-the-Ramah ; make-shout Beth-aven Aven, after-you Benjamin.
Ephraim to/for-horror she-will-be, in-day-of rebuke ; in-tribes-of Israel, I-have-made-know faithfuled.
officials-of Judah like-making-remove-of have-been, border ; on-them, I-will-pour like-the-waters fury-of-me.
oppressed Ephraim crushed-of justice ; for has-made-willing, command has-gone after.
and-I like-the-moth to/for-Ephraim ; and-like-the-rottenness to/for-house-of Judah.

Ephraim and-has-seen sickness-of-him and-Judah wound-of-him, and-has-walked Ephraim toward Asshur, and-has-sended toward king Yareb ; and-he not will-able to/for-heal to/for-you-pl, and-not wound will-cure from-you-pl.
for I like-the-lion to/for-Ephraim, and-like-the-lion to/for-house-of Judah ; I I will-tear and-will-walk, will-lift and-naught making-rescue.
I-will-walk I-will-return toward place-of-me, until who will-guilty faces-of-me and-have-sought ; in-the-distress to/for-them they-will-seek-me.
walk and-let-us-return toward YHWH, for he has-teared and-will-heal-us ; he-will-make-smite and-he-will-saddle-us.
he-will-live-us from-days ; in-the-day the-third, he-will-make-rise-us and-we-will-live to/for-faces-of-him.
and-let-us-know we-will-pursue to/for-know YHWH, like-dawn established outgoing-of-him ; and-will-come like-the-rain to/for-us, like-spring land will-make-show.
what I-will-do to/for-you Ephraim, what I-will-do to/for-you Judah ; and-kindness-of-you-pl like-cloud-of morning, and-like-the-dew making-rise going.
on thus I-have-hewed in-the-prophets, I-have-killed-them in-words-of lip-of-me ; and-justices-of-you light will-exit.
for kindness I-have-delighted and-not sacrifice ; and-knowledge-of god from-burnts.
and-they, like-Adam have-passed covenant ; there they-have-treacherouslied in-me.
Gilead, town-of working-of evil ; insidious from-blood.
and-like-wait man bands spell-of priests, way will-murder Shechem-ward ; for wickedness they-have-done.
in-house-of Israel, I-have-seen horror ; there fornication to/for-Ephraim, Israel has-been-defiled.
also Judah, has-set harvest to/for-you-f ; in-return-of-me captivity-of people-of-me.
like-heal-of-me to/for-Israel iniquity-of Ephraim and-has-been-heglamed and-evils-of Samaria, for have-worked deception ; and-thief will-come, band has-striped in-the-outside.
and-not they-will-say to/for-heart-of-them, all-of evil-of-them I-have-remembered ; now deeds-of-them have-turned-them, before faces-of-me have-been.
in-evil-of-them they-will-rejoice king ; and-in-lies-of-them officials.
all-of-them commiting, like ovens, burning from-baking ; will-cease making-rouse, from-knead dough until leaven-of-him.
officials have-made-weak day-of king-of-us,, rage-of from-wine ; hand-of-him has-drawn with scorning.
for they-have-presented like-the-ovens heart-of-them in-ambush-of-them ; all-of the-night sleeping baking-of-them, morning, he burning like-fire-of flame.
all-of-them they-will-warm like-the-ovens, and-they-have-eaten judging-of-them ; all-of kings-of-them they-have-fallen, naught calling in-them toward-me.
Ephraim, in-the-peoples he will-mix ; Ephraim has-been bun without overturned.
they-have-eaten stranger strength-of-him, and-he not has-known ; also greyheaded has-scattered in-him, and-he not has-known.
pride-of Israel and-has-answered in-faces-of-him ; and-not they-have-returned toward YHWH god-of-them, and-not they-have-sought-him in-all-of this-f.
Ephraim and-has-been, like-dove enticing naught heart ; Egypt they-have-called Asshur they-have-gone.
like-when they-will-walk I-will-spread on-them net-of-me, like-bird-of the-heavens I-will-make-go-them ; I-will-make-discipline-them, like-report to/for-congregation-of-them.
woe to/for-them for they-have-wandered from-me, violence to/for-them for they-have-transgressed in-me ; and-I will-ransom-them, and-they, have-spoken on-me lies.
and-not have-outed toward-me in-heart-of-them, for beds-of-them ; will-make-wail on on grain and-new they-will-quarrel they-will-turn in-me.
and-I have-disciplined, have-strengthened arms-of-them ; and-toward-me they-will-devise evil.
will-return not most have-been like-bow-of deceit, officials-of-them will-fall in-the-sword from-indignation-of tongue-of-them ; this derision-of-them in-land-of Egypt.
toward palate-of-you trumpet, like-the-eagle on house-of YHWH ; because they-have-passed covenant-of-me, and-on instruction-of-me they-have-transgressed.
to/for-me they-will-out ; god-of-me we-have-known-you Israel.
Israel good has-rejected ; enemying he-will-pursue-him.
they have-made-reign and-not from-me, have-made-rule and-not I-have-known ; silver-of-them and-gold-of-them have-done to/for-them idols, sake will-be-cut.
calf-of-you-f Samaria has-rejected, has-kindled nose-of-me in-them ; until how, not they-will-able innocence.
for from-Israel and-he, artificer has-done-him, and-not god he ; for calf-of Samaria will-be, fragments.
for spirit they-will-sow and-whirlwind they-will-reap ; standing naught to/for-him branch without will-do flour, perhaps will-do, stranger they-will-swallow-him.
Israel has-been-swallowed ; now they-have-been in-the-nations, like-article naught pleasure in-him.
for they have-ascended Asshur, wild alone to/for-him ; lovers have-made-hire Ephraim.
also for they-will-hire in-the-nations now I-will-gather-them ; and-have-made-begin little, from-burden-of king officials.
for Ephraim has-made-multiply altars to/for-sin ; altars have-been to/for-him to/for-sin.
I-will-write write-him, ten-of abundance-of instruction-of-me ; like stranger they-have-been-devised.
sacrifices-of gifts-of-me will-sacrifice flesh and-have-eaten, YHWH not has-accepted-them ; now iniquity-of-them will-remember and-will-reckon offenses-of-them, they Egypt will-return.
Israel and-has-forgotten doing-of-him and-has-built temples, and-Judah, has-made-multiply cities gather ; and-I-have-sended fire in-cities-of-him, and-has-eaten citadels-of-her.
do-not let-rejoice Israel toward rejoicing like-the-peoples, for you-have-fornicated on god-of-you ; you-have-loved wages, on all-of threshings-of grain.
threshing and-wine not will-pasture-them ; and-new will-deceive in-her.
not they-will-dwell in-land-of YHWH ; Ephraim Egypt and-has-returned, and-in-Asshur unclean they-will-eat.

not will-pour to/for-YHWH wine and-not sacrifices-of-them will-pledge to/for-him like-food-of evils to/for-them, all-of eating-of-him will-defile ; for food-of-them to/for-soul-of-them, not will-come house-of YHWH.
what you-pl-will-do to/for-day-of meeting ; and-to/for-day-of feast-of YHWH.
for behold they-have-gone from-violence, Egypt Memphis will-gather-them she-will-bury-them ; desire-of to/for-silver-of-them nettle will-possess-them, thistle in-tents-of-them.
days-of the-punishment have-come have-come days-of the-recompense, will-know Israel ; fool the-prophet maded man-of the-spirit, on abundance-of iniquity-of-you, and-many hatred.
watching Ephraim with god-of-me ; prophet snare-of fowler on all-of ways-of-him, hatred in-house-of god-of-him.
they-have-made-deep they-have-ruined like-days-of the-Gibeah ; iniquity-of-them will-remember, will-reckon offenses-of-them.

like-grapes in-the-wilderness I-have-found Israel, like-fig in-fig in-first-of-her, I-have-seen fathers-of-you-pl ; they have-come Lebaal Peor and-have-been-dedicated to/for-the-shame, abominations and-have-been like-love-of-them.
Ephraim, like-the-bird will-fly glory-of-them ; from-beget and-from-belly and-from-conception.
that if they-will-magnify sons-of-them, and-I-have-bereaveded-them from-man ; for also woe to/for-them in-turn-of-me from-them.
Ephraim like-when I-have-seen to/for-Tyre transplanted in-pasture ; and-Ephraim, to/for-make-exit toward killing sons-of-him.
give to/for-them YHWH what you-will-give ; give to/for-them womb making-bereaved, and-breasts shriveling.
all-of evil-of-them in-the-Gilgal for there I-have-hated-them, on evil-of deeds-of-them, from-house-of-me I-will-drive-them ; not let-me-make-add love-of-them, all-of officials-of-them rebeling.
Ephraim has-been-made-smite, root-of-them has-withered fruit without not they-will-do ; also for will-beget, and-I-have-made-die desires-of belly-of-them.
god-of-me will-reject-them, for not they-have-heard to/for-him ; and-they-will-be wandering in-the-nations.
vine luxurianting Israel, fruit will-set to/for-him ; like-abundance to/for-fruit-of-him he-has-made-multiply to/for-the-altars, like-good to/for-land-of-him, pillars have-made-improve.
heart-of-them has-smoothed now they-will-guilty ; he will-neck altars-of-them, will-ruin pillars-of-them.
for now they-will-say, naught king to/for-us ; for not we-have-feared YHWH, and-the-king what will-do to/for-us.
words have-spoken, swear vanity cut covenant ; justice, and-has-sprouted like-the-poison on furrows-of sirion.
to/for-heifers-of Beth-aven Aven, they-will-dread neighboring-of Samaria ; for people-of-him has-mourned on-him and-pagans-of-him on-him will-rejoice, on glory-of-him for has-heglamed from-him.
also him to/for-Asshur will-be-made-conduct, offering to/for-king Yareb ; shame Ephraim will-take, Israel and-will-blush from-counsel-of-him.
ceased Samaria king-of-her ; like-splinter on faces-of waters.
highs-of evil and-have-been-destroyed offense-of Israel, thorn and-thistle, will-ascend on altars-of-them ; and-they-have-said to/for-the-mountains cover-us, and-to/for-the-Gibat fall on-us.
from-days-of the-Gibeah, you-have-sinned Israel ; there have-stood, not battle will-make-overtake-them in-the-Gibeah on sons-of iniquity.
in-desire-of-me and-I-will-discipline-them ; peoples, and-have-been-gathered on-them in-bind-of-them to/for-two-of fountains-of-them iniquitieses-of-them.
and-Ephraim heifer learned loving-of to/for-tread, and-I have-passed, on goodness-of neck-of-her ; I-will-make-ride Ephraim will-plow Judah, will-harrow to/for-him Jacob.
sow to/for-you-pl to/for-rightness reap to/for-lip-of kindness, break to/for-you-pl ground ; and-time to/for-seek YHWH, until will-come, righteousness and-will-make-show to/for-you-pl.
you-pl-have-plowed wickedness injustice-of you-pl-have-reaped you-pl-have-eaten fruit-of lie ; for you-have-trusted in-way-of-you in-abundance-of mighty-of-you.
roar and-has-risen in-people-of-you and-all-of fortifications-of-you will-be-ruined, like-violence-of Shalman Beth-arbel Arbel in-day-of battle ; mother on sons has-been-piecesed.
thus Lebeyt Bethel, has-done to/for-you-pl from-faces-of evil-of evil-of-you-pl ; in-the-dawn, be-cease king-of Israel has-been-ceased.
for youth Israel and-I-have-loved-him ; and-from-Egypt I-have-called to/for-son-of-me.
they-have-called to/for-them ; thus they-have-gone from-faces-of-them, to/for-the-Baal they-will-sacrifice, and-to/for-the-idols they-will-offer.
and-I have-taught to/for-Ephraim, he-has-taken-them on arms-of-him ; and-not they-have-known for I-have-healed-them.
in-mahalabs-of man I-will-draw-them in-cords-of love, and-I-have-been to/for-them like-making-exalt-of yoke on Lehi-of-them ; and-I-will-make-stretch toward-him I-will-make-eat.
not land-of Egypt, and-Asshur he will-return toward king-of-him ; for they-have-refused to/for-return.
sword and-has-twisted in-cities-of-him, and-has-finished alones-of-him and-has-eaten ; from-counsels-of-them.
